title: Local native egress observation before owner teardown v1
description: Closed ten-field nonactionable local projection, at most 8191 compact UTF-8 bytes. The producing client retains actual proof/host/creation/workload/kernel owners through bounded stdout and final checks. Workload scalars are observations, not portable authority or proof of continuing process/namespace ownership. Owner drop tears down the never-executed child. The SDK checks shape only and never consults a journal, socket, kernel or namespace. Preserve producer exit status; parsing cannot prove final producer success.
